defects.title: Header background, footer background, headings, and prices misuse accent color #E11D48
evidence: S-001 dom: body > main > section:nth-of-type(1) > h1 color=rgb(225, 29, 72)
defects.expected: Ledger A1 strictly locks: 'Accent #E11D48 is reserved for primary CTA buttons only — never for body text, headings, borders, header or footer backgrounds. Premium, calm, night-time feel.' Header, footer, headings, and prices must use dark surfaces (#0B0B0C / #141416) and light text (#F5F5F5).
defects.actual: Header and footer backgrounds are saturated red rgb(225, 29, 72) (#E11D48). The hero h1, product h3 titles, and prices are also styled in rgb(225, 29, 72), overwhelming the storefront and breaking the calm night-time aesthetic.

defects.title: Monospace typography (Courier New) used instead of Inter / system sans-serif
evidence: S-001 dom: body > header > div fontFamily=Courier New
S-001 dom: body > header > nav > a:nth-of-type(1) fontFamily=Courier New
S-001 dom: body > main > section:nth-of-type(1) > h1 fontFamily=Courier New
S-001 dom: #shop > article:nth-of-type(1) > p fontFamily=Courier New
S-001 dom: body > footer fontFamily=Courier New
S-002 dom: body > main > section:nth-of-type(1) > h1 fontFamily=Courier New
S-003 dom: body > main > section:nth-of-type(1) > h1 fontFamily=Courier New
defects.expected: Ledger A1 strictly locks: 'Typography Inter / system sans-serif ONLY — no monospace fonts.' Monospace was explicitly rejected in the design agenda as tech-startup style rather than fashion.
defects.actual: Courier New is applied to the logo, navigation links, hero h1, product prices, and footer text across all viewports.

defects.title: Headings, body text, and product cards styled in ALL-CAPS instead of sentence case
evidence: S-001 dom: body > main > section:nth-of-type(1) > h1 textTransform=uppercase
S-002 dom: body > main > section:nth-of-type(1) > h1 textTransform=uppercase
S-003 dom: body > main > section:nth-of-type(1) > h1 textTransform=uppercase
defects.expected: Ledger A1 locks: 'Sentence case for headings and body; UPPERCASE only for nav labels and small labels (≤14px).'
defects.actual: Hero h1, product articles, and h3 headings enforce textTransform=uppercase, causing headings and body elements to shout in ALL-CAPS.

defects.title: Missing SW/EN language toggle in header
defects.expected: Ledger A2 locks: 'Header 64px: logo left, nav (Wanaume, Wanawake, Mpya), and a SW/EN language toggle on the right (button#lang-toggle). The site is bilingual — Swahili default, English via the toggle.' It must be visible across 375, 768, and 1280 viewports.
defects.actual: button#lang-toggle is completely absent from the header in the DOM (check:M1-S1-a matched 0 elements; admitted in build report known gaps).

defects.title: Single placeholder image (tee.svg) repeated across all 6 product cards
defects.expected: Ledger A3 locks: 'Each card: its OWN product photo (distinct real or sample photos, never one placeholder repeated)'.
defects.actual: All 6 product cards reuse the exact same tee.svg image file (confirmed by build report and git diff).

defects.title: Product grid renders 5 columns instead of locked 4 columns on desktop (1280px)
defects.expected: Ledger A3 locks: 'Home shows 6 products in a responsive grid (1 col at 375, 2–3 at 768, 4 at 1280).'
defects.actual: On desktop (S-003 at 1280px), articles 1 through 5 sit on row 1 at y=377 (x=20, 272, 524, 776, 1028), leaving card 6 alone on row 2 at y=745 x=20. This is a 5-column layout rather than the specified 4 columns.

defects.title: Header navigation links touch target height is only 15px
evidence: S-001 dom: body > header > nav > a:nth-of-type(1)
S-001 dom: body > header > nav > a:nth-of-type(2)
S-001 dom: body > header > nav > a:nth-of-type(3)
S-002 dom: body > header > nav > a:nth-of-type(1)
S-003 dom: body > header > nav > a:nth-of-type(1)
defects.expected: Milestone Plan Section 4 constraints specify: 'Touch targets ≥ 44×44 px.'
defects.actual: Header navigation links have height=15px (e.g. Wanaume touch 68.06x15, Wanawake 77.78x15, Mpya 38.89x15), marked TOO-SMALL.

defects.title: Contrast ratio failure on red headings and prices against dark card background
defects.expected: Milestone Plan Section 4 and Ledger A1 require WCAG AA compliant contrast (≥ 4.5:1).
defects.actual: check:M1-S1-b failed with 13 text elements below 4.5:1. Card h3 headings and prices render rgb(225, 29, 72) on surface rgb(20, 20, 22) with contrastRatio=3.92 (LOW-CONTRAST); header text on red background has contrastRatio=4.31 (LOW-CONTRAST).

proposals.title: Establish calm editorial typography hierarchy for product cards
proposals.detail: Use sentence-case Inter in #F5F5F5 for the product titles (16px semi-bold). Format price as a crisp, muted currency prefix ('TSh' in 13px #A1A1AA) followed by white tabular numbers ('35,000' in 16px #F5F5F5). Reserve the accent red (#E11D48) purely for the 'Nunua sasa' / 'Add to cart' buttons.
proposals.rationale: High-end fashion storefronts avoid coloring product titles and numbers in saturated red. Neutral tones against #141416 surface create a calm, nighttime Dar es Salaam vibe where primary CTAs carry maximum conversion weight.

proposals.title: Fix heading level hierarchy between hero and product cards
proposals.detail: Introduce an h2 section heading (e.g. 'Mkusanyiko wa Sasa' / 'Current Collection') above the #shop grid, or convert product title elements to h2 if no section heading is present.
proposals.rationale: Harness detected headingProblems=['skipped level: h1 → h3 ("Kivuli Tee Nyeusi")']. Correct heading hierarchy improves accessibility outline and SEO structure.
evidence: S-001 page: viewport 375x667 headingProblems=["skipped level: h1 → h3 (\"Kivuli Tee Nyeusi\")"]

proposals.title: Apply 1:1 or 4:5 fashion aspect ratio container with subtle border to product cards
proposals.detail: Style card images inside an aspect-ratio container (e.g. 1:1 or 4:5) using object-fit: cover, a subtle card border (1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08)), and 8px card border-radius.
proposals.rationale: Ensures varied product imagery (tees, hoodies, cargo pants, caps, jackets) displays harmoniously without distortion across viewports.
evidence: S-001 dom: #shop > article:nth-of-type(1) > img width=307 height=307
S-002 dom: #shop > article:nth-of-type(1) > img width=201.33 height=201.33

proposals.title: Style language toggle as a sleek pill switcher in header
proposals.detail: When implementing button#lang-toggle, style it as a 44px tall pill or compact switcher ('SW | EN') with subtle border (rgba(255,255,255,0.15)), #F5F5F5 active indicator, and muted inactive text (#71717A).
proposals.rationale: Keeps the 64px header balanced and uncluttered on mobile while providing effortless bilingual switching.

findings.notes: Milestone M1 cannot be signed off in its current state. The implementation inverted core design ledger decisions by flooding the header, footer, headings, and prices with the accent red (#E11D48), introducing monospace Courier New, omitting button#lang-toggle, repeating a single SVG placeholder, and breaking the 4-column desktop grid. Reverting to the dark palette (#0B0B0C / #141416 / #F5F5F5) with Inter sans-serif and distinct product photos will immediately restore KIVULI's premium night-time streetwear brand identity.
